**Repair only.** One fix, to the fish monger's hidden perk, in two parts. Nothing new.

## The skulls that didn't count

0.6.0 gave the Port District's fish monger a secret: sell him enough vodyanoi skulls and he
notices something about how they're built, and tells you. It was unreachable, and a tester's
saves showed exactly why.

**Haggled sales didn't count.** Talk him up to fifty gold a skull and the skull changed hands
without being counted. Only the plain twenty-five-gold sale advanced the tally.

**And once he was full, nothing counted.** After enough skulls he declares *"a problem of supply
and demand"* and buys the rest at ten gold apiece -- through a different piece of script that
0.6.0 never touched. Most players hit that around the eighth skull. From then on every sale
was invisible to the perk, so the threshold could not be reached by anyone.

Every sale to him now counts, at whatever price. When the fifteenth lands he says his piece
about the soft spot, and the perk is yours.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over 0.8.3 as normal. This is dialogue
only and takes effect on any save -- but skulls sold before installing stay uncounted, so if
you're mid-way, it's fifteen from wherever the count already stands.
